title: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answe
question:
What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: single bond refers to bond_type = '-'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) where bond_type = '-'

prediction.sql:
SELECT printf('%.5f', CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.XCL_004))
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
WHERE b.XCL_006 = '-';
